problems.quote: the factor for that year becomes (1 + r₁/100) t × (1 + r₂/100) 1‑t
problems.problem: Mid-year rate change factor incorrectly written as multiplication by t and 1-t instead of exponentiation
problems.correction: the factor for that year becomes (1 + r₁/100)^t × (1 + r₂/100)^(1‑t)
